verdict: The Poisson model cannot reproduce the observed dispersion (2.32 against replicates near 1, p = 0.000); the quiet years of districts over 10 km sit at the edge of its range (p = 0.12). The negative binomial reproduces both.
A model that understates year-to-year variation is too sure of every district's rate, so the Day 4 plan would look less risky than it is.
